meta.description: Every-2-days auto-poster to Instagram (2-step container->poll->publish) and Facebook Page. Credentials from env via the bedrock-broadcaster-meta ExternalSecret: META_PAGE_TOKEN, IG_ACCOUNT_ID, FB_PAGE_ID. Rotates every post through 6 IG-valid brand images (5 reframed marketing scene cards + brand square, hosted on R2 at social.bedrockbroadcaster.com/posts/) with captions that complement each card's baked-in headline, plus layered/rotating hashtags. FB photo posting requires the app to hold pages_manage_posts (reports a clear error until granted). Images must be publicly reachable + IG-valid aspect (4:5 or 1:1).
